Vicks Tricks
Out of all the different combinations of drugs that I've tried, this is definitely one of the MOST intense, scariest, and pleasurable combinations.
Me and a few of my close friends were having a big rolling party. I swallowed my 2 white anchor pills and when I started to roll, one of my friends gave me a light show and a vicks inhaler. One of my friends asked me if I wanted to take it another step. 'Sure, why not', I said, not even knowing what he was talking about. He had me stand close to a wall and bend down as far as I could with my waist, and my head facing the floor. He told me to take 10 deep breaths with my head towards the floor and on the 10th, he'd hit me with the Vicks and I'd have to inhale and exhale the vicks 10 times as fast and as hard as I could and on the last one, hold it in and lean my back and head against the wall and my friend pushed my chest in while I was against the wall and my other friend held my air passages closed for about 7 sec., all of a sudden I blacked out and got back up and didnt even know what was going on, it was soooo crazy, everything that had happened to me in the last 19 years, I'd forgotten about. I had no idea who I even was. When my memory finally came back to me, everyone was staring at me and screaming and laughing with their eyes wide open. This was very strange. I didnt know what hit me. Then I'd come to find out that they'd taken pictures of me on the ground wigging out and talking to myself! This was amazing! Then we tried it on some more ppl and it worked!
It is the most amazing trick I've ever seen w/ vicks while rolling.
